question: During a sale 50% of the goods are sold at 45% profit, 30% of the remaining goods are sold at 27% profit and the still remaining goods are sold at a loss of 43%. If there is an overall profit of x%, then what is the value of x?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the total quantity of goods be 100 units.

The divided parts are: 50 units (+45%), 15 units (+27%), and 35 units (−43%).

Net Profit % = [(50 × 45) + (15 × 27) + (35 × −43)] ÷ 100

Net Profit % = [2250 + 405 − 1505] ÷ 100 = 1150 ÷ 100 = 11.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 11.5%.**
